name: Mediterranean Herbed Lamb Kofta with Couscous, Cucumber & Tomato Salad

instructions.primary_message: In a medium saucepan, bring broth to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, remove from heat, add couscous, and stir to combine. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes; fluff with a fork.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup whole wheat couscous
2 cups chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (0.5 oz) pkg Mediterranean-inspired fresh herb blend
½ lemon
½ English cucumber

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince shallot. Divide between two medium bowls (set one bowl aside for the salad).

Shave oregano and dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add herbs to the remaining bowl with the shallot along with lamb and spices. Mix with your hands until well combined. Using a ¼-cup measure, form the beef mixture into 8 long, sausage-like shapes, approximately 6-inches long. Place kofta on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb ground lamb
1 tsp cumin, ground
1 tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Add kofta and cook, undisturbed, until golden brown underneath, about 5 minutes; turn and cook an additional 5-7 minutes, until cooked through. Transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, pick parsley and mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add herbs to the remaining bowl with the shallot.
Zest and juice lemon into the bowl.
Trim and small dice cucumber. Add to the bowl.
Small dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl along with cooked couscous, oil, salt, and pepper, then stir to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad and kofta between plates. Enjoy!
